descriptions.isochrone_compute: Returns a GeoJSON polygon of everywhere reachable from an origin within one cost budget. cost_type selects the product: `time` (cost_value in seconds, max 7,200) or `distance` (metres, max 100,000); cost_value must satisfy 0 < cost_value <= max or the call returns HTTP 400. direction is `outbound` (default: where you can reach from the origin) or `inbound` (who can reach the origin). Travel modes: auto, motorcycle, truck, pedestrian. The origin must lie inside India. One contour per call, so the response has exactly one feature, and the mode is echoed in features[0].properties.cost_type. Geometry is encoded polylines by default; send encode_geojson=false for plain [longitude, latitude] GeoJSON arrays. Required: cost_type, cost_value, origin. Optional: departure_time, direction (default: outbound), enable_smoothing (default: false) (plus 6 more).
descriptions.route_compute: Calculates the optimal route between 2+ waypoints within India, with multiple travel modes, alternate routes and route modifiers. Geometry (`geometry` and every `legs[].shape`) is returned as encoded polyline strings (precision 6) unless you send `output_format: { 'encode_polyline': false }`; maneuvers are off unless you send `output_format: { 'maneuvers': true }`. Max locations per request: auto 20, motorcycle 50, truck 20, pedestrian 50; exceeding it returns HTTP 400. There is no pre-check for maximum distance. Required: geo_coords. Optional: alternate_routes (default: false), departure_time, output_format (plus 3 more). Returns array of RouteComputeItem.
